notes.title: Tri Survive Launch Update: Endless Mode Fixes on the Way!
notes.content:
[p]Greetings Survivors!

Tri Survive is finally out! Our very first game release, a huge milestone for us at Majestic Mind Games. But as much as we’d love to take a moment to celebrate, we’re already hard at work on the next updates.

One of the first things on our radar is the Endless Mode, those of you who have completed all levels and started testing your true survivability skills in the Endless Mode may have noticed some issues we want to address right away:[/p][p][/p][p]- Performance drops, If you survive for long enough, the enemy hordes get too crazy, making things choppy if you’re not clearing them fast enough.[/p][p]- Level cap stuck at 50, after this point, no more stat bonuses (attack speed, damage, etc) are applied to the heroes. And no more special cards appear on leveling up (Heal, Triangle Ability Re-charge, Riches).[/p][p]-  EXP/Gold overflow, past level 51, orbs and gold pile up under your heroes and don't actually get collected.[/p][p][/p][p]We want you to know we’re on top of this. We’re working on improving the Endless Mode design, optimizing performance during those hectic late game runs, and raising the level cap so you can keep pushing your limits!
[/p][p]Our goal is to have the first patch out next week.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all so much for jumping in, sharing your feedback, and being part of this launch journey with us. And we look forward to enhancing and refining Tri Survive with you.
[/p][p] Stay strong, and tri to survive! ♥[/p][p][/p][p]– The MMG Team[/p]

- EXP/Gold overflow, past level 51, orbs and gold pile up under your heroes and don't actually get collected.

notes.title: Devlog #5 – Introducing the New Demo: Expanded Content & Major Upgrades
notes.content:
Hey Survivors!

We’re thrilled to share that this devlog is centered around the upcoming Tri Survive demo, releasing on May 16th, and what you can expect when you dive into it. A lot has changed since the last build we shared during the Alpha playtest we did back in January, and we can’t wait to hear what you think!
You can download the demo [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3698210/Tri_Survive_Demo/]here[/url].

Before getting started, we remind you that this demo will be open to anyone. This means that anyone interested can navigate to the Tri Survive Demo page, download the demo, and start playing it instantly (on May 16th).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098699/fc5f67d267e18952c877b0cd1f2c48943de61ae1.png[/img]

[h2]What's in the Demo?[/h2]
Players will start with the base 3 heroes:

- Alric, Commander of the Vanguard (tank), 
- Elaria, Light Keeper of the Crown (healer),
- Ignis, Archmage of the Eternal Flame (DPS),

Each has distinct abilities tied to their roles and synergizes in combat. 

And you can get familiar with the gameplay with the starting characters through the first 2 levels:

- Castle Courtyard.
- Rocky Desert.

The Castle Courtyard is where the story begins and is considered the tutorial level. Reading some quick dialogue between the characters before you begin the fight sets up the story and the background for the game, as well as some dialogue with the first boss you encounter. And upon completing that level, you will unlock the Rocky Desert, where you continue your journey in battling the demonic invasion that has plagued the lands and unraveling the mystery of why and where those demons are coming from.

Completing the 2nd level will unlock your first new hero, “Granite, Heart of the Earth” (tank). This big, beefy boy packs quite a punch! So it will be fun to experience a new character with his own set of attacks and abilities, and you can choose to replay the first 2 levels again with the new dynamic that he brings to the team.

You can also experience the [b]Tri Ultimate Ability[/b]: a powerful attack that is performed by all 3 heroes at once and you can manually trigger it (by pressing F) once it is charged-up during combat and offers devastating power that can get you out of a tough situation, help you finish off the boss or mow down that army of demos that piled up and been chasing you for the past 3 minutes.

Lastly, you will also try out the [b]Power Up Shop[/b], the meta progression system in the game, and where the “rogue-lite” aspect comes in. Here you can purchase upgrades that affect your party's health, damage, speed, and ability cooldowns. In the future, the power-up shop will expand to include upgrades to the individual tank, healer, and DPS roles themselves, regardless of which combination of these heroes you choose in your party.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098699/d875a488df4d6d0959b182951312df1b2faca8fb.png[/img]

[h2]Improvements Since the Last Playtest[/h2]
We’ve been hard at work polishing the experience based on your feedback. Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*] [b]All in-game art has been updated,[/b] including character designs, animations, and interface elements.
[*] [b]Enemy wave balancing[/b] has been significantly refined to improve difficulty curves and flow.
[*] [b]Hero Abilities [/b]balancing and tweaking, your squad will feel more powerful and intentional with their abilities.
[*] [b]UI/UX and VFX improvements[/b] for a smoother experience, and a bit better readability, some of the heroes got improvements to their attack visuals as well. 
[*] [b]A Classic Experience-Based leveling system[/b], where previously you would level up immediately upon picking up “Ability Orbs”, we replaced those with “Experience Obs”, which you collect from slain enemies to fill up your experience bar and then choose an ability upgrade each time you level up.
[*] [b]Audio and Music![/b] We added some cool new sound effects to the heroes' abilities as well as some of the enemies and bosses, where previously it was all lame placeholder sounds. And added a new background music track that is still a work in progress.
[*] [b]Improved Interactive Tutorial[/b], previously we had a bunch of text that you had to read at the start of the level that explained the controls and gameplay, and now it is more integrated within the gameplay, as you get messages periodically that explain the controls.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098699/704fbd2066dbc1fff2ccd400c5a0161078b59325.png[/img]

[h2]Your Feedback[/h2]
As you explore the demo, we’d love your input on what you have experienced and the elements that you found good to play around with, and others that did not convince you fully. Specifically, we want to know more about these main features:
Tri-control mechanic

[list]
[b][*] Story pacing
[*] Abilities & upgrades
[*] UI clarity
[*] Bugs & performance[/b]
[/list]

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/WAmT9SMBmG]Discord Server[/url] to chat with the rest of the community and follow us on our socials to be the first to know about the latest news for Tri Survive!

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Tri Survive Art Design Revamped!
notes.content:
Hey Survivors! 
We have a big announcement to share with you all.
Today, we officially announce the revamp of Tri Survive's main characters’ art style! We've decided to give our characters a new look to make them feel more alive, defined, and integrated into the style we want for the final version of Tri Survive! We would love to hear your thoughts on this, so please let us know if you have any feedback on our socials or Discord community!


[h2]Why We Reworked the Art?[/h2]
After a long evaluation, the development team realized that the previous art design did not reflect Tri Survive's overall mood. Besides the aesthetic factor, we also noticed that during our testing phase, the previous silhouettes and sprites weren’t visible, especially during sections where many enemies were on screen, thus making gameplay more frustrating.


We believe that the new style gives all the main characters a different kind of aura and makes them feel more like “heroes” than before. Now, the designs offer more vibrant colors, better anatomic proportions, and richer details for the protagonists’ armor.

So, how can we describe the revamped Tri Survive Art Design?

The development team took inspiration from video games that are also known for their unique art style, such as League of Legends and Unicorn Overlord. The main influence is the high-fantasy look, which allowed the team to create silhouettes with sharper lines that allow us to develop characters with more personality. Something that our past approach could not replicate as well as now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098699/625dfbe385c02d3fed3f493fcac308e069c62347.gif[/img]

[h2]Before & After[/h2]

notes.title: Tri Survive - Devlog #2: The Alpha Build is Here!
notes.content:
Hey Survivors!

We have some big news to share—the Alpha build is complete! We’ve made huge progress since our last update, and this milestone brings us closer to completing Tri Survive’s development. We have added several core features to offer multiple opportunities to enrich your gameplay possibilities and customization.

Below, you can find more details on the main work we have added in Tri Survive Alpha Build.

[h2]A New Battlefield: Rocky Highlands[/h2]
Introducing Rocky Highlands, a treacherous new map filled with rugged rocky terrain. Brace yourself for new enemies, unpredictable hazards, and intense battles that will test your survival skills like never before!


The introduction of Rocky Highlands marks key progress for Tri Survive by offering a diversified map pool that not only diversifies the type of environment you will find during your adventures but also introduces you to new enemies, ambient hazards, and obstacles that will test your combat skills and coordination while controlling your party.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098699/6d9fa8254c3d9ee6b127777ce2f59a20dc7a5334.png[/img]

[h2]Power-Up Shop: Strengthen Your Heroes[/h2]
We’ve added a Power-Up Shop, giving you a way to enhance your heroes mid-run. Spend resources to unlock upgrades, boost stats, and modify your playstyle for each session. Strategy matters—choose wisely!

The Power-Up Shop’s purpose is to customize your gameplay even further by letting you decide, based on your current needs, which are the best upgrades for your party! This means you can choose the most fitting playstyle based on your current situation: do you need more survivability, AoE damage, or movement speed to counter your enemies' attacks? The Power-Up Shop will be your best friend and help you out in your journey to save the world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098699/d732303d3de9cd8029e61b35d5fca02bfbb1f812.png[/img]

[h2]
What’s Next?[/h2]
With most of the core game systems almost completed, our focus is currently on gameplay balance, expanding and improving the overall player experience, character art and visuals, polishing the UI, and preparing for the next phases with beta testing and a public demo soon! 

Wishlist Tri Survive on Steam and join our [url=https://discord.gg/QXGQZWGZ72]Discord server[/url] to be part of the journey!
